title: Simple Server Set: Base
description: Base branch of the Simple Server Set project.
body:
![Simple Server Set Banner](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/NotPiny/d728e90af15f74d7c09e60e26a8627e0/raw/ffaa1088a4926efcda036ae6ca54bcf0d2f6476e/simple-server-set-banner.svg) ## Base Edition! A simple modpack built for general use, built on top of the [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpacks/fabulously-optimized) modpack. It is designed to always be up to date with Fabulously Optimized within at most an hour of their release. ## Other Editions This version of the Simple Server Set not quite fit? Look at all the others on [our organization](https://modrinth.com/organization/simple-server-set) or go the github linked in the panel. ## Make your own! You can easily make your own by forking [our repo](https://github.com/NotPiny/SimpleServerSet), and hey maybe contribute back to us :) ## Licenses There are some non-Modrinth projects we've included via overrides that require special licensing and attribution.
